comment: ADEUK: TITANS launch trailer v3 ('우리'), docs/cinema/TRAILER_V3.md. The single source of truth: every shot says what it is for; times are timeline seconds (edit them to retime; shots must stay contiguous). Real fights are deterministic (match seed/script/startTick); cinema-only beats are actors (src/cinema/actors).

shots.comment: ACT 0, 0:00. Black. Two heartbeats, slightly out of phase: two hearts (sound only; S6 cues at 0.35 L and 0.95 R).

0:02. MATTER CAM: one pixel of 우리's hot core fills the screen (x48, each native pixel a lit tile), seething in x0.25; at 0:04 the snap pull-back (exponential, 18 frames, zoom about the core) shows it is 우리, its fist mid-swing toward something off-screen. Freeze at 0:06 (a frame before the blow lands at 0:46).
0:06. Hard cut to white (5 frames).
0:06. Then black. Card: 아득. Silence.
ACT I, 0:07. Two worlds in a slow binary orbit (the real Planet in palettes A and B), city lights breathing on their night sides. A long, still, gentle wide shot. The 우리 motif first, as two notes.

ACT I (P2 gate). 0:12. Over World A's horizon a gold arc rises like a sunrise: the real Witness backs away from behind the planet (stick held left, x0.6) and the picture is turned a quarter (dutch 1) so 'away' is 'up'. Wrong colour, too slow.
ACT I (P2 gate). 0:15. EXTREME CLOSE-UP, first beat: the eye at x4, its halo arcs clicking back into alignment notch by notch.
ACT I (P2 gate). 0:16. The eye at x8, filling the frame: the black pupil contracts as it finds its target.
ACT I (P2 gate). 0:17. Its real Fracture Gaze (the signature, scripted) strikes World A; the wide holds until the first crack opens.

ACT I (P2 gate). 0:18. MATTER CAM, tight on the crack line (x24: about 27×15 native pixels, each a big lit tile): the crack opens (x0.25), time is pushed through the lull, the second gaze shears it (x0.4).

ACT I (P3 gate). 0:20-0:24 in one take. World B alone (the real Planet in palette B, a dummy; World A is far off-frame). The Mouth is the LOCKED oracle baked frame by frame (tools/cinema/mouth-strike.ts), drawn in front of the world; its bite at 2.9 s is a real catastrophic blow on World B's matter (match.blows): half the world goes, debris, a flash, the shake moves the bars. SILENCE #1 after the bite (S6).
ACT II, 0:24. The ruin in the silence: two naked cores, the wreck drifting, arks like embers. Room tone only.
ACT II 27.00–30.78: the two cores are hauled together and the loop ignites (wide).
ACT II 30.78–33.44: a part lands on its drum hit (MATTER CAM on the landing, x4).
ACT II 33.44–33.98: a part lands on its drum hit (wide).
ACT II 33.98–34.83: a part lands on its drum hit (MATTER CAM on the landing, x4).
ACT II 34.83–35.94: a part lands on its drum hit (wide).
ACT II 35.94–37.02: a part lands on its drum hit (MATTER CAM on the landing, x4).
ACT II 37.02–37.91: a part lands on its drum hit (wide).
ACT II 37.91–38.20: a part lands on its drum hit (MATTER CAM on the landing, x4).
ACT II 38.20–38.50: a part lands on its drum hit (wide).
ACT II 38.50–41.00: the fists form from rubble; the command moon locks (wide).
ACT II 41.00–44.00: 우리 lifts its head and braces (wide).

cards.text:
우리는 아직 여기 있다.
We are still here.

shots.comment: ACT II 44.00–46.00: it launches at the camera (wide).
ACT III, 0:46. The letterbox BURSTS open to 16:9 on 우리's first landed hit (vs Planet, real gameplay: the fist of the cold open). The full score enters.
ACT III montage: 우리 vs planet (nursery, seed 2, P5 take #0); the blow lands 0.8s in; name slam on the cut.
ACT III insert: MATTER CAM on the Planet's wound shearing (x12, tracking it, matter only).
ACT III card: NO HEALTH BARS.
ACT III montage: 우리 vs blackhole (tussenruimte, seed 3, P5 take #5); the blow lands 0.8s in; name slam on the cut.
ACT III montage: 우리 vs supernova (redgiant, seed 4, P5 take #10); the blow lands 0.8s in; name slam on the cut.
ACT III insert: MATTER CAM on 우리's own wound under the Supernova's blow (x12).
ACT III card: YOUR BODY IS THE BAR.
ACT III montage: 우리 vs nexus (shearfield, seed 4, P5 take #16); the blow lands 0.8s in; name slam on the cut.
ACT III montage: 우리 vs asteroid (rim, seed 1, P5 take #20); the blow lands 0.8s in; name slam on the cut.
ACT III montage: 우리 vs blackhole (tussenruimte, seed 1, P5 take #6); the blow lands 0.6s in; name slam on the cut.
ACT III, 1:02. Slow motion (x0.3): a Supernova nova engulfs 우리; the loop strains and HOLDS. Music ducks to the heartbeat.
ACT III, 1:05. Through the light, gold rings: the Witness turns. Eye to core: x8 on the eye, its rings clicking (rhymes with 0:15).
ACT III, 1:08. Witness beams against 우리, matter tearing on both; a fist travels at the eye... CUT TO BLACK a frame before impact (1:12).
SILENCE #2: black.
ACT IV, 1:17. A wide of the arena after the fight, still (x0.2); debris drifts. Room tone.

ACT IV, 1:20. Stars on all four edges slide to the rim; a coil slides along the bottom edge; neither titan notices. 1:23 the pull-back: the arena (the real fight, drawn first: `arena`) shrinks into the Mouth's coils (S7's edgepull). HUNGER. DEVOURS. ENDS. REPEATS., one per coil pass (edgeWordCues).

ACT IV, 1:29. The jaw-rings close over the camera (S7's jawwipe: the real teeth rows as an iris), bite, black. (The fight is hidden here: the pull-back ended on the arena as a small rectangle in the coils, so what shows through the closing gullet is the dark.)
ACT IV, 1:31. Title: ADEUK: TITANS · 아득 / FREE IN YOUR BROWSER / FINAL BOSS: COMING (S7 title). One final hit; a long tail.
ACT IV, 1:34. Post-title sting: black, two heartbeats, then a third, wrong one (sound only).
